plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 5-date timeline completes: 31 Oct 1794 (John Dalton in Manchester reads the first scientific study of colour blindness) · 1802 & 1852 (Thomas Young and Hermann von Helmholtz establish three-cone trichromacy) · 28 Jul 1844 (Joseph Ransome dissects Dalton's eyes and proves the vitreous humour is clear) · 1933–1958 (George Wald and Ruth Hubbard prove light snaps Vitamin A's 11-cis-retinal straight into all-trans-retinal) · 17 Feb 1995 (David Hunt and John Mollon extract DNA from Dalton's 150-year-old eye and prove he lacked the middle-wavelength green-cone gene) alongside the mammal 2-cone vs human 3-cone vs bird 4-cone spectrum comparison.
